paragraphs: R. Chanina Anatya. R. Yonah and R. Assi [the retrieved Berakhot has R. Yosi] were with him: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 6, mishnah 5. Kelal Gadol has Antonya. Terumot, chapter 2: he went up with R. Zeira to Chammat Gerar [the retrieved Terumot has Chammat Gader]. Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 1, and beginning of Chelek: before R. Mana. R. Yosi told him, “You and R. Yirmeyah said in Resh Lakish's name”—Avodah Zarah, chapter 5, halakhah 11.
